name: OFAC-API (sanctions screening)
summary: Fuzzy screening of people, companies, vessels and aircraft against OFAC SDN and 20+ other sanctions, PEP and watch lists, single, batch or as async bulk jobs.

api_key.description: An ofac-api.com API key, sent in the apiKey header (the request body's apiKey field also works).

notes: Screening and search are reads sent as POST with a JSON body.
Always check error and errorMessage in the body: a 200 can still say the account is over its monthly limit.
Matches come back only when their score clears minScore (default 95, range 80-100); lower it for looser fuzzy matching.
Batches: up to 500 cases per screen or search call; larger sets (up to 100,000) go through jobs.create and are polled with jobs.get.

endpoints.name: Screen names against sanctions lists
endpoints.summary: Scored matches for each case, with the fields that matched and the full sanction record.

cases.description: Cases, each {name (required), id (recommended, echoed back), type (person|organization|vessel|aircraft), dob YYYY-MM-DD, gender, citizenship, nationality, phoneNumber, emailAddress, cryptoId, address {address1, address2, city, stateOrProvince, postalCode, country}, identification [{idNumber, type, country}]}.

minScore.description: Lowest match score returned, 80 to 100, default 95.

sources.description: Sanction list codes to check, e.g. SDN, NONSDN, UN, OFSI, FCDO, DFAT, SECO, PEP, INTERPOL, FINCEN (full list on the Data Sources page). All configured lists when omitted.

types.description: Entity types to evaluate: person, organization, vessel, aircraft.

options.description: {caseReportPdf: {include: true}} adds a Base64 PDF report per case (subscription only, at most 100 cases).

notes: A read over POST. type on a case improves matching but does not filter; types at the top level filters.

endpoints.name: Search sanctions lists
endpoints.summary: Sanction records matching a name, address, ID number or crypto wallet, without screening scores.

cases.description: Cases, each {name (required), id, cryptoId, address {address1, address2, city, stateOrProvince, postalCode, country}, identification [{idNumber, type, country}]}.

sources.description: Sanction list codes to check, e.g. SDN, NONSDN, UN, OFSI, FCDO, DFAT, SECO, PEP, INTERPOL, FINCEN (full list on the Data Sources page). All configured lists when omitted.

types.description: Entity types to evaluate: person, organization, vessel, aircraft.

notes: A read over POST. Up to 500 cases per call.

endpoints.name: Start a bulk screening job
endpoints.summary: Queue up to 100,000 cases for asynchronous screening; returns a job id.

sources.description: Sanction list codes to check, e.g. SDN, NONSDN, UN, OFSI, FCDO, DFAT, SECO, PEP, INTERPOL, FINCEN (full list on the Data Sources page). All configured lists when omitted.

types.description: Entity types to evaluate: person, organization, vessel, aircraft.

idempotency_key.description: A UUID v4; retrying with the same key returns the original job.

notes: Starts a billed job: it only produces data and changes nothing else in your account.
Poll ofacapi.jobs.get with the returned id until COMPLETED.

endpoints.name: List screening jobs
endpoints.summary: Recent bulk jobs and their status.

endpoints.name: Get a screening job
endpoints.summary: Status of a bulk job and, once COMPLETED, a reportUrl to download the results.
notes: reportUrl expires 24 hours after this call; call again for a fresh link.
